name: my-wallet
description: My Wallet v1.4 (محفظتي) - Offline-Ready Personal Finance & Hybrid Accounting SPA

scripts.prepare:www: mkdir -p www/assets && cp index.html app.js www/ && cp -r assets/* www/assets/

scripts.build:android: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug assembleRelease
